boundary: This inventory records trusted compiler patches and kernel-checked backend portability changes. It is not a verified compiler theorem or a completed full-verifier correspondence. The inactive Charon experiment is not used by extract.sh.
backend_check: LEAN_NUM_THREADS=2 lake build Aeneas AeneasMeta WhirAeneas.Std.Bulk WhirAeneas.Std.Guards WhirAeneas.Toolchain.StringLiteral

patches.purpose: Model release-MIR wrapping shifts for every signed and unsigned RHS type without truncating the original RHS bits to u32.
patches.reproducer: WhirAeneas.Std.Shift and Aeneas.Std.WrappingShiftRhs universal mask lemmas; executed Rust/Lean shift comparisons.

patches.purpose: Expose the owned Vec IntoIter content alias by making the existing definition an abbreviation, without changing its value semantics.
Replace the String.toStr default native-decide proof with a kernel proof.
patches.reproducer: WhirAeneas.Toolchain.StringLiteral: original audit exposes assertMessage._native.decide.ax_1; patched audit contains only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

patches.purpose: Port enum conversion realization, simplifier result types and changed arithmetic elaboration APIs to Lean 4.34.
patches.reproducer: Pinned AeneasMeta.BvEnumToBitVec, AeneasMeta.Simp.Simp and affected arithmetic tactic modules under Lean 4.34.

patches.purpose: Expose the existing alignment alias required by module compilation and reuse the upstream Array theorem instead of declaring a colliding theorem.
patches.reproducer: Pinned Aeneas.Std.Core.Ptr and Aeneas.Data.Array under Lean 4.34.

patches.purpose: Reuse upstream Vector set theorems and prove indexing and slice updates through existing Array lemmas.
Port coinductive module exposure and local notation, confining the transparency compatibility option to coinductive modules.
Remove obsolete wording-only unsolved-goal fixtures, rather than repinning Lean diagnostic rendering.
patches.reproducer: Pinned Aeneas.Tactic.Conv.Bvify.Tests rendered diagnostics under Lean 4.34; actual bit-vector proofs remain in the checked backend.

patches.purpose: Remove obsolete unused-variable wording fixtures from do-notation examples instead of treating diagnostic text as a semantic contract.
Prove Slice reconstruction using checked slice extensionality and preserve clone length through its returned dependent witness.
patches.reproducer: Pinned Aeneas.Std.SliceDef and Aeneas.Std.Slice under Lean 4.34.

patches.purpose: Port BvTac and Step to the changed Lean APIs, retaining kernel-checked certificates and canonicalizing bit-vector width aliases.
patches.reproducer: Pinned BvTac and Step proof examples under Lean 4.34.

patches.purpose: Scope coinductive compatibility to its Coin proof example and remove obsolete tuple unused-variable wording fixtures.
patches.reproducer: Pinned Aeneas.Tactic.Step.Tests.Coin and TupleDestruct under Lean 4.34; actual tuple and coinductive proofs remain checked.

patches.purpose: Name the Std.Discriminant instance generated by the `discriminant` attribute after its inductive (`<inductive>.instDiscriminant`) instead of leaving it anonymous, whose automatic name dropped the namespace. Two extractions of the same Rust enum (fiat_shamir::error::TranscriptError in ReplaySource and MerkleSource) otherwise both declare `instDiscriminantTranscriptErrorIsize` and cannot be imported together. The instance's type and body are unchanged.
patches.reproducer: Importing WhirAeneas.Generated.Replay.Types and WhirAeneas.Generated.Merkle.Types in one module fails with `environment already contains 'instDiscriminantTranscriptErrorIsize'` before the patch; WhirAeneas.NativeCompose imports both after it.
patches.status: active; full backend and WhirAeneas rebuilt

patches.purpose: Give distinct associated-type parent-trait fields distinct generated names without changing Rust traits or generated output manually.
patches.reproducer: tests/copy_parents.rs and check-generator.sh: duplicate Copy parent fields fail before; unedited generated Lean compiles after.

patches.purpose: Skip only methodless missing-trait impl metadata with no semantic reference anywhere in the translated crate; fail loudly on a referenced or nonempty impl.
patches.reproducer: tests/unused_impl_metadata.rs and check-generator.sh, including the negative parsed-IR reference fixture.
patches.status: active; checked positive execution and negative rejection

patches.purpose: Preserve only the three registered array stdlib declarations used by late synthesis in monomorphic mode, use the same generic trait declarations as their callers, and fail loudly when synthesis would reference a missing declaration. Generic extraction behavior is unchanged.
patches.reproducer: check-charon-array.py and tests/array_builtin_mono.rs: original repeat_seed extraction contains a missing Fn2 reference and is rejected; repaired unedited computable Lean compiles, executes seeds 0, 17, 255 in agreement with Rust, and tests/array_builtin_mono_check.lean proves universal returned content with only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Excluding core::array::repeat fails loudly before partial calls are emitted. The concrete PCS root retains complete LLBC; this does not establish full verifier correspondence.
patches.status: active; original rejection, repaired compilation and execution, and exclusion guard checked

patches.purpose: Retain the pointee and allocator generic arguments of builtin Box in monomorphic extraction, rejecting any unexpected generic shape; preserve all other monomorphic behavior and strict projection checks.
patches.reproducer: tests/box_monoprojection.rs with optimized MIR, monomorphization and initialized_hashes as the root. Original Charon fails the two-type projection assertion; patched Charon typechecks complete LLBC with has_errors=false. Aeneas still rejects a later Unique-to-raw-pointer slice coercion, so generated Lean is not claimed checked.
patches.status: inactive experiment; not used by extract.sh
